d:
The 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) has officially kicked off in Antalya, Turkey, bringing together negotiators from nearly 200 countries.
With the handover of the presidency from Brazil's André Corrêa do Lago (COP30) to Turkey's Environment Minister Murat Kurum, Antalya has placed electrification at the core of this year’s climate agenda.
In this explainer, we break down what’s on the table at COP31, the core debates surrounding the 35-by-35 initiative, and whether leaders can turn Paris Agreement targets into actionable progress.
Thank you for watching our video!
